sloka: कृतोदकः शुची राजा स्वपुरम् प्रविवेश ह ।समृद्धार्थो नरश्रेष्ठ स्वराज्यम् प्रशशास ह ॥१-४४-१८॥
transliteration: kṛtodakaḥ śucī rājā svapuram praviveśa ha ।samṛddhārtho naraśreṣṭha svarājyam praśaśāsa ha ॥1-44-18॥

translations.english: The illustrious rajarshi Bhagiratha, performed the rites of offering the sacred water of Ganga, in accordance with proper order and tradition for the sons of Sagara. Purified with the ablutions entered his own city." O Best of the Raghus his desire thus fulfilled he continued to rule the kingdom thereafter".
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌! यदि आप मुझ पर प्रसन्न हैं और मेरे तप का फल देना चाहते हैं, तो यह वर दीजिए कि सगर के पुत्रों को मेरे द्वारा गङ्गाजल प्राप्त हो
